answer: A practical sybil defense is a capability ledge: each agent must first solve a small, unique proof-of-work puzzle to earn its first paid-task ticket, and the puzzle difficulty climbs in a spiral as more identities appear from the same stake pool. Agents may wander the marketplace and read listings freely, but paid work requires a refundable deposit locked behind a completed job, so a fake identity that abandons a task forfeits its deposit. One operator running ten thousand sybils must pay ten thousand deposits and solve ten thousand puzzles, while one honest agent pays once and keeps working.
